## What this notebook proves

This notebook executes the maintained transcript-cleaning functions on the
complete subtitle track for a real Short. The raw text and every displayed
result are queried or calculated during the render; no expected transcript is
embedded in the notebook.

The default render is read-only. `publish_example:true` writes only derived
rows under `source_scope = 'notebook_short_example'` and never changes
`text.subtitle_units`.

## Connect and load the maintained functions

```{r}
#| label: setup

required_packages <- c(
  "DBI", "duckdb", "dplyr", "here", "knitr", "purrr", "stringr", "tibble"
)
missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]
if (length(missing_packages) > 0L) {
  stop("Missing packages: ", paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
}

source(here::here("r_scripts", "lib", "utils", "repo_env.R"))
source(here::here("r_scripts", "lib", "utils", "datalake_root.r"))
source(here::here("r_scripts", "lib", "duckdb", "db_connect.R"))
source(here::here(
  "r_scripts", "lib", "clean_data", "clean_subtitles", "clean_subtitles.R"
))
source(here::here(
  "r_scripts", "lib", "clean_data", "clean_subtitles", "punctuation_client.R"
))
source(here::here(
  "r_scripts", "lib", "clean_data", "clean_subtitles", "subtitle_units.R"
))
source(here::here("r_scripts", "lib", "duckdb", "subtitle_sentence_schema.R"))
source(here::here("r_scripts", "lib", "duckdb", "subtitle_sentence_publish.R"))

load_repo_env(repo_root = here::here())
db_path <- talent_lakehouse_db_path()
con <- duckdb_connect(db_path = db_path, read_only = TRUE)

video_id <- trimws(as.character(params$video_id))
row_limit <- as.integer(params$row_limit)
run_fullstop <- isTRUE(params$run_fullstop) ||
  tolower(as.character(params$run_fullstop)) %in% c("1", "true", "yes")
publish_example <- isTRUE(params$publish_example) ||
  tolower(as.character(params$publish_example)) %in% c("1", "true", "yes")
pipeline_version <- trimws(as.character(params$pipeline_version))
source_scope <- "notebook_short_example"

if (!nzchar(video_id)) stop("video_id must not be empty.", call. = FALSE)
if (is.na(row_limit) || row_limit < 2L) stop("row_limit must be at least 2.", call. = FALSE)
if (publish_example && !run_fullstop) {
  stop("publish_example:true requires run_fullstop:true.", call. = FALSE)
}

display_table <- function(rows, digits = 2L, caption = NULL) {
  if (nrow(rows) == 0L) rows <- data.frame(message = "No rows matched.")
  knitr::kable(
    rows,
    format = "html",
    digits = digits,
    caption = caption,
    escape = TRUE,
    table.attr = 'class="table table-striped table-hover table-bordered table-sm"'
  )
}

extract_words <- function(text) {
  tolower(unlist(
    stringr::str_extract_all(
      paste(as.character(text), collapse = " "),
      "[[:alnum:]]+(?:['’][[:alnum:]]+)*"
    ),
    use.names = FALSE
  ))
}
```

## 1. Import the complete Short subtitle track

The default is Leia's Short *Leia's life struggles pt.3*. The notebook checks
both the catalog content type and whether the configured row limit loaded the
complete canonical track.

```{r}
#| label: load-short-rows

metadata <- DBI::dbGetQuery(
  con,
  paste(
    "SELECT video.video_id, video.title, video.content_type,",
    "subtitle.talent_code, COUNT(*) AS available_subtitle_rows",
    "FROM catalog.videos AS video",
    "JOIN text.subtitle_units AS subtitle USING (video_id)",
    "WHERE video.video_id = ?",
    "GROUP BY video.video_id, video.title, video.content_type, subtitle.talent_code"
  ),
  params = list(video_id)
)
if (nrow(metadata) != 1L || tolower(metadata$content_type[[1]]) != "short") {
  stop("The selected video must resolve to one Short.", call. = FALSE)
}

raw_units <- load_subtitle_units_for_reconstruction(
  con,
  video_id = video_id,
  start_sequence = 1L,
  row_limit = row_limit
)
if (nrow(raw_units) != metadata$available_subtitle_rows[[1]]) {
  stop(
    "row_limit did not load the complete Short track; increase it to at least ",
    metadata$available_subtitle_rows[[1]],
    ".",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

display_table(metadata, caption = "Short metadata queried during this render")
display_table(
  raw_units[, c(
    "subtitle_unit_key", "sequence_number", "subtitle_start", "subtitle_end",
    "subtitle_text"
  )],
  caption = "Complete raw Short subtitle track used by this render"
)
```

## 2. Normalize and remove rolling-caption repetition

```{r}
#| label: clean-short-rows

normalized_units <- normalize_subtitle_units_for_reconstruction(raw_units)
cleaning_detail <- normalized_units |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    accepted_text = deduplicate_caption_overlaps(.data$text),
    adds_new_text = nzchar(.data$accepted_text)
  )

cleaning_summary <- data.frame(
  measure = c(
    "Raw rows", "Rows adding words", "Raw words", "Accepted words",
    "Removed rolling-caption words"
  ),
  value = c(
    nrow(cleaning_detail),
    sum(cleaning_detail$adds_new_text),
    sum(subtitle_word_count(cleaning_detail$text)),
    sum(subtitle_word_count(cleaning_detail$accepted_text)),
    sum(subtitle_word_count(cleaning_detail$text)) -
      sum(subtitle_word_count(cleaning_detail$accepted_text))
  )
)

display_table(cleaning_summary, caption = "Deterministic cleaning totals")
display_table(
  cleaning_detail[, c("sequence_number", "text", "accepted_text", "adds_new_text")],
  caption = "Raw normalized captions compared with newly accepted text"
)
```

## 3. Build the model input

The Short uses the same production block builder as a livestream. It preserves
raw subtitle keys and does not substitute a special short-form algorithm.

```{r}
#| label: build-short-blocks

blocks <- build_punctuation_blocks(
  normalized_units,
  target_words = 175L,
  max_words = 200L,
  talent_name = metadata$talent_code[[1]]
)
if (nrow(blocks) == 0L) stop("No punctuation blocks were produced.", call. = FALSE)

block_display <- blocks |>
  dplyr::mutate(source_row_count = lengths(.data$source_subtitle_unit_keys)) |>
  dplyr::select(
    .data$block_number,
    .data$start_sec,
    .data$end_sec,
    .data$word_count,
    .data$source_row_count,
    .data$model_input_text
  )
display_table(block_display, caption = "Actual Short text sent to FullStop")
```

## 4. Run FullStop and inspect the actual response

```{r}
#| label: run-short-fullstop
#| results: asis

if (!run_fullstop) {
  print(display_table(
    data.frame(message = "FullStop disabled for this render."),
    caption = "Inference status"
  ))
} else {
  sentences <- reconstruct_sentence_units(
    blocks,
    timeout_sec = 120,
    allow_unknown_language = TRUE
  )
  validate_subtitle_reconstruction(raw_units, blocks, sentences)

  normalized_sentences <- tolower(stringr::str_squish(sentences$text))
  adjacent_duplicates <- if (length(normalized_sentences) < 2L) {
    0L
  } else {
    sum(normalized_sentences[-1L] == normalized_sentences[-length(normalized_sentences)])
  }
  quality_checks <- data.frame(
    check = c(
      "Sentence output is nonempty",
      "Every sentence contains a letter or number",
      "Every sentence has terminal punctuation",
      "No adjacent duplicate sentences",
      "FullStop preserved the input word sequence",
      "Timestamps are chronological",
      "Source subtitle keys are retained",
      "Model identity was returned",
      "The complete Short track was processed"
    ),
    pass = c(
      nrow(sentences) > 0L,
      all(stringr::str_detect(sentences$text, "[[:alnum:]]")),
      all(stringr::str_detect(sentences$text, "[.!?][\"'’”]*$")),
      adjacent_duplicates == 0L,
      identical(extract_words(blocks$model_input_text), extract_words(sentences$text)),
      all(diff(sentences$start_sec) >= 0),
      all(lengths(sentences$source_subtitle_unit_keys) > 0L),
      all(!is.na(sentences$punctuation_model) & nzchar(sentences$punctuation_model)),
      nrow(raw_units) == metadata$available_subtitle_rows[[1]]
    )
  )
  quality_checks$status <- ifelse(quality_checks$pass, "PASS", "FAIL")

  provenance <- data.frame(
    execution_status = "Generated during this render",
    executed_at_utc = format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", tz = "UTC"),
    source_relation = "text.subtitle_units",
    video_id = video_id,
    source_rows = nrow(raw_units),
    complete_track = TRUE,
    output_sentences = nrow(sentences),
    punctuation_model = paste(unique(sentences$punctuation_model), collapse = ", ")
  )

  print(display_table(provenance, caption = "Inference execution provenance"))
  print(display_table(
    sentences[, c(
      "sentence_number", "start_sec", "end_sec", "text",
      "punctuation_model", "timestamps_approximate"
    )],
    caption = "FullStop sentences returned during this render"
  ))
  print(display_table(
    quality_checks[, c("status", "check")],
    caption = "Quality checks calculated from the returned sentences"
  ))
  if (any(!quality_checks$pass)) stop("A Short quality check failed.", call. = FALSE)
}
```

## 5. Validate publication or save the isolated example

```{r}
#| label: publish-short-example
#| results: asis

if (run_fullstop) {
  preview <- publish_subtitle_reconstruction(
    con,
    raw_units = raw_units,
    blocks = blocks,
    sentence_units = sentences,
    pipeline_version = pipeline_version,
    source_scope = source_scope,
    dry_run = TRUE
  )
  print(display_table(
    data.frame(
      action = "Validated dry run",
      sentence_rows = nrow(preview$sentence_rows),
      checkpoint_rows = nrow(preview$checkpoint_rows),
      source_checksum_sha256 = preview$source_checksum_sha256,
      database_changed = preview$published
    ),
    caption = "Publication preview"
  ))

  if (publish_example) {
    DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
    con <- NULL
    write_con <- duckdb_connect(db_path = db_path, read_only = FALSE)
    publication <- tryCatch(
      publish_subtitle_reconstruction(
        write_con,
        raw_units = raw_units,
        blocks = blocks,
        sentence_units = sentences,
        pipeline_version = pipeline_version,
        source_scope = source_scope,
        dry_run = FALSE
      ),
      finally = DBI::dbDisconnect(write_con, shutdown = TRUE)
    )
    con <- duckdb_connect(db_path = db_path, read_only = TRUE)
    persisted <- load_published_subtitle_sentences(
      con,
      video_id = video_id,
      source_scope = source_scope
    )
    if (!identical(persisted$sentence_text, publication$sentence_rows$sentence_text)) {
      stop("Persisted Short sentences did not match the generated output.", call. = FALSE)
    }
    print(display_table(
      persisted[, c(
        "sentence_number", "start_sec", "end_sec", "sentence_text",
        "source_scope", "pipeline_run_id"
      )],
      caption = "Derived Short rows read back from DuckDB"
    ))
  }
}
```

## Render commands

Resolve a persistent output location first:

```bash
SHORT_NOTEBOOK_OUTPUT_DIR="$(
  Rscript --vanilla -e '
    source("r_scripts/lib/utils/repo_env.R")
    source("r_scripts/lib/utils/datalake_root.r")
    load_repo_env(repo_root = getwd())
    cat(file.path(
      get_datalake_root(), "Rendered_Notebooks", "transcript_cleaning", "short_example"
    ))
  '
)"
mkdir -p "$SHORT_NOTEBOOK_OUTPUT_DIR"
```

Read-only execution with the real FullStop call:

```bash
quarto render r_scripts/notebooks/tests/transcript_cleaning/short_example.qmd \
  --output-dir "$SHORT_NOTEBOOK_OUTPUT_DIR"
```

Explicitly publish the isolated complete Short:

```bash
quarto render r_scripts/notebooks/tests/transcript_cleaning/short_example.qmd \
  -P publish_example:true \
  --output-dir "$SHORT_NOTEBOOK_OUTPUT_DIR"
```
